author: GovRonDeSantis
text:
Great to be in Lakeland today to break ground on the new Florida Archery Center at Teneroc and highlight the Hunting, Fishing, and Camping Sales Tax Holiday. Through December 31, Floridians can buy firearms, ammunitions, accessories, and a wide range of hunting, fishing, and camping equipment tax-free.  

A full list of tax-free items is available at http://FloridaRevenue.com/HuntFishCamp.
